title: The Second Angle — Product Viewpoint Transfer
description: Source-conditioned product viewpoint transfer of the verified CR-003 Refraction Ledger perfume photograph: depict the same unbranded faceted-glass bottle from a clearly distinguishable eye-level three-quarter camera viewpoint approximately thirty degrees off the source near-frontal perspective, while preserving recognizable product design, transparent faceted glass, distinctive shoulder geometry, brushed-metal cap proportions, pale limestone plinth, and restrained neutral studio character. Uses installed route reference_transform with symbolic roles artifact/environment/palette only (no layout/pose/identity lock of the source frontal frame). No TransformationPack, no numeric camera-yaw field, no 3D-reconstruction claim. Operator must supply the verified CR-003 PNG (SHA-256 43a9ff6e0a0aaed177fae1145ac3e1ed88566ab507952c4e68fde97d10b3d1c4) as the image to condition at generation time. See docs/CR_010_THE_SECOND_ANGLE.md. No gallery image attached.

semantic_spec.request: Using the attached existing CR-003 Refraction Ledger product photograph as the sole product-design reference, produce one new studio product photograph of that same unbranded luxury perfume bottle from a clearly distinguishable new camera viewpoint—an eye-level three-quarter view approximately 30 degrees off the source near-frontal perspective—so additional bottle depth and a different side-facet arrangement become readable. Preserve recognizable product identity: transparent faceted-glass construction, distinctive shoulder geometry, central body proportions, cylindrical brushed-metal cap, cap-to-body relationship, clear colorless glass, understated premium styling, unbranded design, pale limestone plinth, and restrained neutral studio setting with the overall lighting character. Allow perspective foreshortening, apparent front-versus-side facet widths, reflected highlights, refraction patterns, cap ellipse/cylinder shading, and plinth perspective to change naturally with the new viewpoint. Do not invent a different perfume design, do not keep the source near-frontal framing, do not require identical highlights or pixel-perfect silhouette match across viewpoints, and do not claim exact 3D reconstruction of unseen geometry—infer only a physically plausible continuation of partially hidden surfaces.

references.notes: Authoritative private CR-003 Refraction Ledger verified import original. SHA-256 43a9ff6e0a0aaed177fae1145ac3e1ed88566ab507952c4e68fde97d10b3d1c4. Resolve the locally verified CR-003 original through private candidate/import evidence during operator handoff. This single PNG is the existing product photograph whose design must govern the result; it is not a second style inspiration. Roles: artifact for bottle form, faceted-glass construction, brushed-metal cap, and surface condition; environment for pale limestone plinth and restrained neutral studio surround without locking camera placement; palette for clear colorless glass, satin metal, and warm-neutral stone relationships. Deliberately omit layout and pose so the source near-frontal framing and object-facing orientation are not imported as locked composition. Omit person-oriented identity. PromptRecipe encodes symbolic roles only; the operator must attach that PNG in the same generation request. The SHA identifies bytes and does not prove upload. No mask is supplied or authorized. No exact 3D reconstruction is claimed.
